entries.ac8e81132d83ce64: This is a single segment providing “Laxus,” a subscription-based sharing service for branded bags. Members can use branded bags for a flat monthly fee, with free exchange and unlimited use. It also offers “Kaechau Laxus,” which lets members buy bags they are renting, and sells bags in the bag resale market. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,280 million, and the number of contracts as of March 31, 2026 (including double plans) was 19,254.
